title: Convert to Base -2
summary: Given an integer n, convert it to its base -2 representation as a binary string, ensuring no leading zeros except for the string "0".
statement: Given an integer n, convert it to its base -2 representation as a binary string, ensuring no leading zeros except for the string "0".
constraints: Return its canonical base -2 digits without leading zeros.
hints: Repeated division works for negative bases when remainders are normalized to zero or one.
Use divmod(n,-2); if remainder is negative, increment quotient and add two to remainder.
Collect digits until zero and reverse them.
Each step preserves old n=(-2)*quotient+remainder with a valid digit.
